exercises.title: Travel & Holidays — Reading
exercises.passage: Last August, Ben travelled to Scotland with his aunt. They stayed in a small guesthouse near a lake. They visited an old castle, walked in the hills and bought souvenirs. Ben took many photographs but forgot his umbrella.

questions.question: Where did Ben stay?
questions.answer: In a guesthouse near a lake
